title: command.form.receipt props, contract version 1
description: The props of the decorator of the receipt a run of the generic command form shows, a decorator point (PRD 13.4): the command's name and contract version, the receipt the command answered with, as receipt.v1.json writes it, and the problem details of a rejection, as problem.v1.json writes them, or null. A contribution to it adds content around the receipt and a badge, and tightens nothing. The page holds the props in the browser, once the command answered. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\CommandForm\Domain\Dto\CommandFormReceiptV1.

command.description: The name of the command the form ran, such as entry.create: lowercase segments in snake_case joined by dots, at least two.

problem.description: The problem details of a rejection, as problem.v1.json writes them, or null for any other outcome.

receipt.description: The receipt the command answered with, as receipt.v1.json writes it.

version.description: The contract version of the command the form ran, 1 or more.
